req.title: Return 404 for unknown player ID
req.statement: The system shall return HTTP 404 when no player exists for the given ID on GET /players/{playerId}.

doc.reasoning: The requirement mandates HTTP 404 for GET /players/{playerId} when no player exists for the given ID. Tests cover: (1) positive EP — a known UUID from the seed data returns 200 with correct payload; (2) negative EP — a well-formed UUID that does not exist in the DB returns exactly 404; (3) BVA — a UUID that is syntactically invalid (malformed) returns 422 (FastAPI path validation), distinguishing the 'bad format' boundary from the 'valid format but absent' 404 case; (4) NEG/DT — nil UUID (all-zeros) is valid UUID format but absent from DB, must return 404 not 200; (5) STC — verifying the status code is exactly 404 and not 200/422/500 for the unknown-ID path, catching operator-flip mutations on the status constant.

tests.name: test_get_player_by_known_id_returns_200
preconditions: Database is pre-loaded with 26 seed rows
trace: R-PLAYER-003: positive path — existing player ID must return 200, not 404
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

def test_get_player_by_known_id_returns_200():
    r = client.get('/players/97da2849-d73e-4b43-8a90-7d090402c802')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    assert body['id'] == '97da2849-d73e-4b43-8a90-7d090402c802'
    assert body['firstName'] == 'Anjali'
    assert body['lastName'] == 'Banerjee'
    assert body['squadNumber'] == 1

def test_get_player_last_seed_id_returns_200_not_404():

    assert r.status_code == 200
    assert r.status_code != 404
    body = r.json()
    assert body['id'] == '77a3ac92-52d1-48c4-871c-73988df20dc8'
